_note: Pinned model, not '-latest': a moving alias would change the voice mid-experiment. Switched 2026-11-26 from gemini-3.5-flash to gemini-4-hydrogen, on the same day the formats and the language rules were reset: in a side-by-side test it wrote natural Hinglish and real-sounding chats, 5 of 6 posts passing every gate, while 3.5-flash was down all afternoon. It is slow (~2.5 min a call). posts_per_trend 3 so one run yields ~10-12 candidates and --auto 6 is still the top half — see generate.yml for the backlog arithmetic.
_note_fallback: Only when every attempt on the pinned model is a 503/504/429, in order. Added 2026-11-26 after the pinned model answered nothing all afternoon and generate kept failing with an empty queue. Each post records which model wrote it in its `model` field, so a comparison can leave fallback posts out.
_note_repo: Where the buttons on the Pages site file their commands. The site is static and this repo is public, so a page cannot hold a token — a prefilled issue is the one way a tap becomes a workflow with no secret in the HTML. See control.py.
_note_windows: Windows, not instants, and the deadline is the part that moved. GitHub does not deliver the cron it is given: from 2026-09-18 12:58 to 18:19 the */20 publish poll was due ~16 times and ran ONCE, and generate's schedule has fired once in its life. The 15:00-17:00 window was missed outright with a post sitting in the queue. So 'after' is still the researched best time and nothing publishes before it — 'before' is now hours later, because a window only catches a poll if it is wide enough to be hit. min_publish_gap_minutes is the cost of that: widening the deadlines put the end of one window within an hour of the next window's start, and two posts in one hour compete for the same audience. --now ignores it. A fixed UTC offset rather than a timezone name because IST has no DST.
_note_audio: Synthesised in audio.py from the same plan() that draws the frames, so the keystroke ticks cannot drift off the typing. Sines only, every envelope a raised cosine, nothing below ~170 Hz that a phone speaker would swallow. Set false and encode() goes back to muxing silence — the stream stays either way, because a reel with no audio stream has historically been rejected outright.
_note_outro: The mark animation plays at the END. It used to open every reel and it was 23-24%% of the runtime of the three that published — the first 23%%, which is the window Instagram uses to decide whether to show the reel to anybody else. Frame 0 is the hook now. Shorter too: a sign-off has less work to do than an introduction.
_note_styles: Which reel each approved post ships as (brain.pick_style): whichever style is furthest behind its weight, counted since 2026-11-26. card is the control — the text card with 90 posts of history. Set a weight to 0 to retire a style. `publish.py styles` reads the comparison out.
